title: CREATE TABLE, data types and constraints

objectives.text: Write a CREATE TABLE statement that chooses a suitable data type for each column (integer, numeric, text or varchar, boolean, date or timestamp)
Enforce a design's rules with PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK and DEFAULT
Predict which INSERT a constraint rejects and identify the violated constraint from the error message
